text:
inc-bot: [ALERT] P1 - canary 'inference-api-v2' CrashLoopBackOff x5 on prod-eu-1. 502 spike from canary route. Alert: https://alerts.internal/alert/12345

anne: Ack - Anne (oncall). Investigating. @miguel can you grab pod logs and check rollout history?

miguel: Looking now. kubectl get pods -l app=inference-api,canary=true -n prod
```
inference-api-canary-7a8b9   CrashLoopBackOff   3/3   0s
inference-api-canary-9b0c1   CrashLoopBackOff   3/3   0s
```
Logs show envoy sidecar aborting after readiness failures. Last image: registry.redwood/inference:2026.03.15-rc5

sara: I shipped the canary at 12:02 - I changed readinessProbe path to /healthz during config sync. our probe should be /ready. wdyt?

miguel: That would explain restarts. Also HPA shows minReplicas: 0 (bad). kubectl get hpa inference-api -n prod -> min:0 targetCPU:60% - metrics gap caused scale down.

john: CS says multiple customers hitting 502s and retries. @liz update?

liz: Confirmed - ~12 paying customers affected, mostly streaming endpoints; support volume up. Logged tickets and notified CS leads. ETA for mitigation?

anne: Mitigation plan: 1) flip feature flag use-v2-inference -> false to stop routing to canary, 2) rollback canary image or rollout undo, 3) patch HPA minReplicas to 1. Sara, can you flip the flag? I'll coordinate rollback.

sara: Flipping flag now via flags service...
```
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/flip -d '{"flag":"use-v2-inference","value":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```
:white_check_mark: Flag flipped.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by anne. Rolling deployment inference-api/canary to revision 1234.

miguel: Rollback applied. New pods coming up:
```
kubectl get pods -l app=inference-api -n prod
inference-api-0a1b2   Running  3/3   12s
inference-api-0a1b3   Running  3/3   10s
```
Patched HPA minReplicas -> 1:
```
kubectl patch hpa inference-api -n prod --type='json' -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/minReplicas","value":1}]'
```

anne: Traffic routing shows error rate dropping. CS: please monitor, escalate if we see reoccur.

liz: Error rate trending back to normal, several customers confirmed recovery. Will keep watching.

anne: Handing off to oliver for next 4h to monitor. Oliver - followups: postmortem, check CI config sync tests, add guard for wrong readiness path, ensure HPA minReplicas enforced in rollout job.

oliver: Taking handoff. I'll drive postmortem and create incident doc. Assigning followups to eng/infra and SRE. :thumbsup: 

inc-bot: Incident resolved. Pager cleared. Follow-up ticket: INC-2026-321 created (owner: oliver).
